XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Ignition of the engine failure light with no apparent abnormality in the operation of the car
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P24C6 | P1103 | SENSOR | PARTICULATE | PARTICULATE FILTER | FAP | DPF | EXHAUST | GAS | LIGHTS UP | ON | MIL | YELLOW | DASHBOARD | INSTRUMENTS | QUANTITY | SOOT | MONITORING | CIRCUIT | RANGE | TEMPERATUREURE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Particulate sensor

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated, whilst vehicle is operating correctly.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P24C6 (Particulate sensor temperature - Open circuit)
  • P1103 (Mass Air Flow Sensor - Performance Range Inconsistency)
  • P139D (Diesel Intake Air Flow Control System B - Leak Detected)
  • P0546 (Exhaust gas temperature sensor upstream of particulate filter, bank 1 - High value)

  • Cause: Faulty particulate sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the particulate sensor and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The sensor is fitted to the exhaust downstream of the particulate filter. After replacement, it is not necessary to reprogram the system using diagnostic equipment. In this case, a visual inspection of the component revealed no abnormalities. Problems with this component are quite common on this engine.
